title: PulseNode
description: The official modpack for the PulseNode server featuring performance improvements, shaders support, voice chat, and many quality-of-life mods.
body:
PulseNode Modpack is the official client modpack for the PulseNode Minecraft server.

This modpack focuses on performance, visual improvements, and quality-of-life features while keeping the core Minecraft gameplay intact. It provides a smooth multiplayer experience with optimized rendering, improved UI, and useful utilities that make playing on the server easier and more enjoyable.

The pack includes performance mods such as Sodium, Lithium, and ModernFix to ensure stable gameplay even with large worlds and many players.

Visual improvements are supported through Iris shaders, dynamic lighting, and enhanced entity rendering, allowing players to customize their graphics without sacrificing performance.

Additional features like Simple Voice Chat, minimaps, world maps, and interface improvements make communication and navigation easier during gameplay.

This pack is designed specifically for the PulseNode server, ensuring compatibility with the server configuration and providing the intended gameplay experience.
